Apple today released the first iOS 27.2 beta version, a move that came as a surprise because a 27.1 version had never been released before. In addition to the all-new Health app, iOS 27.2 beta 1 also extends Siri AI support to five new languages.

Siri AI in iOS 27.2 beta 1 adds support for more languages, including French, Japanese, and Spanish

Siri AI, which launched earlier this week with iOS 27, was initially limited to devices set to English.

However, Apple promised at the time that support for more languages would be coming soon, and for users on the developer beta, that wait has proven to be remarkably short.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 arrives today with Siri AI support for the following new languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Given that this week's release only supported English, this represents a significant expansion.

But now, with the developer beta of iOS 27.2, as long as your device is set to English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, or Spanish, you can use the more powerful Siri AI.

Have you tried Siri AI in iOS 27? How was your experience? Let us know in the comments.
